source_claim: Kyoto Animation's official Nichijou work page names the principal cast, while the official Nichijou site lists additional character-profile entries and character songs for the campaign's named school and Shinonome Laboratory characters.
notes: Kyoto Animation's official Nichijou page identifies the work and its adaptation/production context, names Yuuko Aioi, Mio Naganohara, Mai Minakami, Professor/Hakase, Nano Shinonome, Misato Tachibana, Yuria Sekiguchi, Annaka, Sakurai-sensei, Takasaki-sensei, and Nakamura-sensei in its story/cast listing (https://www.kyotoanimation.co.jp/works/nichijou/). The official Nichijou site character page lists Sasahara Koujirou, Misato, Sakurai-sensei, and Takasaki-sensei among the character-profile entries (https://shinonome-lab.com/character/index.html); its official staff/cast and drama/character-song pages identify the related named cast including the Shinonome Laboratory characters and character-specific songs (https://shinonome-lab.com/staffcast/, https://shinonome-lab.com/goods/cd_index.html). These sources establish direct appearances in the named Nichijou anime; romanized catalog tag forms are retained as the campaign keys.
